name: Jecht, Reluctant Guardian // Braska's Final Aeon
typeLine: Legendary Creature — Human Warrior (front) // Legendary Enchantment Creature — Saga Nightmare (back)
description: Front: Menace. Whenever this creature deals combat damage, you may exile it. If you do, return it to the battlefield transformed. Back: Menace. (As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter.) I, II — Each opponent discards a card. You draw a card. III — Each opponent sacrifices two creatures.
assumptions: Rendered the lore-counter node as the standard fixed Saga reminder line.
Read cond:chapter=1-2 / cond:chapter=3 as grouped chapter headers "I, II —" and "III —".
Rendered sagaSac2 (cond:each_opponent_chooses) as each opponent choosing their own two creatures.
Left the front-face combat-damage trigger's recipient unspecified ("deals combat damage," not "...to a player").
couldNotDerive: Whether node:sagaSelfSac represents printed text or the standard unprinted Saga sacrifice-after-final-chapter rule (714.4) — examiner correctly did not invent a sacrifice sentence for it, treating it as the latter.
Rarity, supertypes beyond what's given, back face color/color identity, whether the exile-return happens "under its owner's control".
notes:
Several real findings, one confirming an earlier open question:

1. Front trigger omitted "to a player" (real: "deals combat damage to a player"). The data has node:onDealsDamage flags "combat player:=damagedPlayer damage:=damageDealt" — the player binding is present, but only as a value later consumed by controlChange; nothing on the trigger node itself directly states the damage recipient category is a player. The examiner could have inferred it (only a player can later gain control) but didn't. Borderline decomposition gap / agent miss — leaning decomposition gap since the fact should probably be stated directly on the trigger, not left to be inferred from a downstream consumer.

2. Front effect omitted "under its owner's control" on the return. Not counted — standard defensive templating for exile-return effects generally, not a fact specific to this card (nothing here ever changes who owns Jecht).

3. Ability sub-names ("Jecht Beam", "Ultimate Jecht Shot") and "of their choice" on the chapter III sacrifice — expected gaps, same as prior cards, not counted.

4. Real, notable finding: the reminder text was reconstructed as only "(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter.)" — missing "Sacrifice after III.", which IS part of the actual printed reminder text (informing the player of rule 714.4, even though it's an SBA, not a triggered ability). This directly confirms the open question flagged earlier in review (whether sagaSelfSac needs its own explicitly named node/sensor, e.g. a role:"sensor" fact for "lore counters >= final chapter") — without one, nothing in the data currently renders as this reminder clause, and the examiner had no way to know it exists. Worth revisiting that open question with this as concrete evidence.
